node.statement: Set X=Z^dagger dot Z. By node 1.1, e<=e_diag, and the root lower-modulus hypothesis for Ha^Q_{R,R}; hence lem-hcb3-diagonal-lower-modulus with P=R gives ||D_n(X)||>=(1-C_diag*e)||X||. Also e>=0 and A>=C_diag, while A*e<=1/2, so 1-C_diag*e>=1-A*e>=1/2. The nonnegative coefficient permits multiplication of node 1.2, yielding ||D_n(X)||>=(1-C_diag*e)(1-B*e)||Z||^2.
